leadership: Elena Viboch — Managing Director, life sciences and health technology
Hemant Taneja — CEO and Managing Director, General Catalyst
profile.model: The firm's life-sciences thesis centers on computationally enabled drug discovery, harnessing biological systems (cell and gene therapy, immunotherapy, protein engineering) and software, services and tools for the industry. It says its core focus is seed and company creation, but it also invests through clinical-stage rounds and public debuts, and it has recently led AI-biology rounds such as Chai Discovery, Manas AI and Maxion.
profile.summary: General Catalyst pairs its large health-assurance and health-system strategy with a growing therapeutics and AI-bio portfolio, reporting about $700M deployed across 30+ life-sciences investments since 2021. Recent outcomes include the ArriVent, Maze, Eikon and Parabilis IPOs and Halozyme's acquisition of Elektrofi.
